title.narrative: Mozambique Health Emergency Preparedness, Response and Resilience Project Using the Multiphase Programmatic Approach

description.narrative: The proposed Mozambique HEPRR Project (MZ HEPRR) corresponds to Phase 7 of the HEPRR MPA (P180127). The project aims to strengthen the preparedness and resilience of the health system to effectively manage health emergencies. Component 1 focuses on enhancing human resources for health (HRH) by improving governance systems, training healthcare professionals, and integrating digital health solutions. This includes the establishment of a digital HRH information management system, policies for equitable staffing, updated curricula incorporating emergency preparedness, and gender-inclusive recruitment strategies. Additionally, the component supports the development of local pharmaceutical manufacturing, improves health commodity supply chains, and establishes a transparent e-procurement system. Component 2 seeks to improve early detection and response to health emergencies through a multisectoral approach. This involves leveraging artificial intelligence for predictive analytics, enhancing integrated surveillance systems, expanding laboratory capacity, and improving emergency coordination. A key focus is ensuring the continuity of essential health services, including maternal health and gender-based violence support, especially during crises. Climate change adaptation is embedded throughout this component, with investments in climate-resilient health facilities and digital tools for early warning systems. Component 3 provides support for project management, monitoring, and evaluation. It ensures effective implementation through operational research, partner mapping, and structured assessments to track progress and impact. Meanwhile, Component 4 serves as a contingency mechanism, allowing for the rapid reallocation of project funds in response to natural disasters or crises. This ensures that emergency response measures can be swiftly enacted when needed.
To strengthen health system resilience and multisectoral preparedness and response to health emergencies in the Republic of Mozambique
